label: Hero Section
title: License Server
subtitle: Issue, validate and meter licenses for your own SaaS products, with resellers, trials and a full audit trail.
className: min-h-[50vh] md:min-h-[70vh] bg-(--st-color-surface) text-(color:--st-color-text-strong) mt-20 rounded-b-lg

label: Key Features
title: A complete licensing platform
subtitle: Everything between your product and a paying customer

items.title: Usage metering and quotas
items.description: Track API calls per organisation against a quota for each billing period, and enforce it automatically.

items.title: SaaS licensing
items.description: Seats plus an API-call quota per period, checked online and tracked per organisation.

items.title: Seat management
items.description: Assign seats to end users, with overflow handling and automatic promotion when seats free up.

items.title: Resellers and clients
items.description: Authorise resellers per product and let them onboard their own client organisations.

items.title: Trials and grace periods
items.description: Instant trials, grace windows and converting a trial to a paid plan in one step.

items.title: Audit trail
items.description: Every issue, renewal, suspension and revocation is recorded and searchable.

label: Integration
title: Drop-in clients for your apps
subtitle: Gate your own application with a few lines. The client activates, checks in, verifies the signed token and fails closed when a licence lapses.

items.title: Signed tokens
items.description: Ed25519 or RSA signed licence tokens that your app verifies on every check.

items.title: Integration keys
items.description: Rotate machine API keys from the admin portal without redeploying.
